cutoff_source: Prior safety report retrieval end; within-day publication times not supplied by most sources.
counting_note: Counts are returned cards per combined query batch, not source-universe totals or unique notices. The tool did not map each card to one query. Search freshness/date filters returned older sources; source dates took priority.
limits: Not a systematic review or exhaustive regulator database enumeration.
Search snippets were screened; only sources in source-checks.json were directly inspected.
No per-ingredient FDA SrLC enumeration or label-by-label text diff.
No national EU databases, raw adverse-event case records, or private manufacturer communications were systematically searched.
FDA date-filtered device recall URL was inaccessible in the web tool; another listing returned stale content. No completeness claim for the device database.
Known October 13 Intuniv document update and October 9 NeuroStar recall were deduplicated against the October 14 baseline.
